entries.back_en: "I must journey to Capital...To Chedo. If thou wert wise, woman, thou wouldst have nothing more to do with me! Thou shouldst not involve thyself in mine affairs!"
"Perhaps this is a result of exposure to the powerful aura of the Eternal Ones..."
"Who are ya! What're ya doin' here!? Mami says you're her cousin that was a guard in Kyoin, but I bet that's not true, is it?"
"She gave herself up and let herself be arrested so you could escape! If she means anything to you, you need to leave here! Go!"
"If the soldiers find you, all of us will get into trouble! You need to leave-- go, get out!"
"There's an old shrine, a kind of sacred temple, on the other side of the forest. I hear that if you go inside, it leads to a village or something somewhere."
"I managed to escape the capital with my life, but now what? What's going to happen to us... To the Empire?"
"I need to look for my daughter... I know she's alive somewhere."
"I don't know for sure, but if you manage to get through the forest, you can escape!"
